scripts.build:demo: DEMO=1 DEMO_BASE=${DEMO_BASE:-/cfw-mailbox/} react-router build && cp build/client/index.html build/client/404.html

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Cloudflare Access team domain, e.g. `https://myteam.cloudflareaccess.com`. Enable one-click Access on the Worker after deploying to get it; until it's set, the app refuses every request.

ACCESS_AUD.description: The Application Audience (AUD) tag of the Access application protecting this Worker. Shown when you enable one-click Access.

ADMIN_EMAILS.description: Comma-separated emails of the people who manage domains, mailboxes and members.

BUCKET.description: R2 bucket for raw messages, large bodies and attachments.

REGISTRY.description: Durable Object holding domains, mailboxes and who may open them.

MAILBOX.description: One Durable Object per mailbox: messages, threads, labels, search.

EMAIL.description: Cloudflare Email Service, for sending. Onboard each domain with `wrangler email sending enable <domain>`.

HEAVY_LIMITER.description: Per-user budget for sends, uploads and exports (30 a minute).

AI_LIMITER.description: Per-user budget for AI Assistant requests (20 a minute).

AI.description: Workers AI, one of the AI Assistant's providers. Billed to this account, and only used when a user picks it.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Any long random string (e.g. `openssl rand -base64 32`). Encrypts the AI provider keys users save. Keep it: changing it makes saved keys unreadable.
